newsitem.title: UK: Fourth tanker to load from Iraqi port - brokers.
newsitem.headline: Fourth tanker to load from Iraqi port - brokers.

text.p: A fourth tanker has been fixed to load Iraqi crude oil at the Gulf port of Mina al-Bakr under the U.N. oil-for-food deal, brokers said on Tuesday.
They said the Norwegian-flagged Berge Bragd was chartered to U.S. company Bayoil to load 290,000 tonnes of crude to the U.K./Continent on January 13 at W55.
Bayoil has contracted to buy 30,000 barrels per day of Iraqi oil over six months.

Some 24 contracts have been signed with foreign oil companies under the United Nations deal, and a U.N. official said on Monday that the ceiling for the amount of oil that Iraq is permitted to export would soon be reached.
The Berge Bragd is the second tanker chartered by Bayoil from Mina al-Bakr. The company last month chartered the 272,000 dwt Leonidas.
Iraqi crude is also being exported from the Turkish Mediterranean port of Ceyhan under the U.N. deal, which led last month to Iraq's first oil exports since its 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
